name: Tie Dye
description: A bullseye tie-dye: soft rings of three dyes spreading out from one point of the cloth, with a pale line left between each pair.

code.style: --rule: ( --a: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2))); --b: @pd(@p(var(--color3), var(--color4))); --at: @calc(50 - @dx * 100 + @pd(@p(-140, -60, 0, 60, 140)))% @calc(50 - @dy * 100 + @pd(@p(-140, -60, 0, 60, 140)))%; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse 160% 160% at @var(--at), transparent 0 40%, var(--color5) 46% 54%, transparent 60%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(@var(--a)); -webkit-mask: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse 160% 160% at @var(--at), transparent 0, #000 6% 14%, transparent 20% 60%); mask: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse 160% 160% at @var(--at), transparent 0, #000 6% 14%, transparent 20% 60%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @var(--b); -webkit-mask: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse 160% 160% at @var(--at), transparent 0 20%, #000 26% 34%, transparent 40% 60%); mask: repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse 160% 160% at @var(--at), transparent 0 20%, #000 26% 34%, transparent 40% 60%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
